fields.Implementation Constraints: Do not change acquisition semantics while introducing analyzers. No automatic network behavior from static analyzers. Preserve workspace lock, path containment, atomic publication, hash re-checks, subprocess timeouts and reconciliation.

fields.Existing Code Mapping: New proposed modules analysis/registry.py, analysis/contracts.py, analysis/executor.py. Adapt src/apkworkbench/analysis/trufflehog.py as first legacy analyzer, preserving existing CLI compatibility during migration.

fields.Target Design: Implement a deliberately small in-process registry of built-in analyzers first; do not build arbitrary third-party plugin loading. Each analyzer is a separately versioned unit with declared capabilities, accepted artifact kinds, config schema, resource limits and deterministic output. Registry creates an execution plan from requested analyzers and available artifact capabilities.
fields.Implementation Constraints: Stable analyzer IDs and semantic versions. No dynamic imports from APK content. Each analyzer gets isolated output directory, timeout, output-byte ceiling and bounded concurrency. Analyzer failure is isolated; malformed output is rejected. Keep CLI independent of analyzer-specific implementation.

fields.Target Design: Airtable is the human/AI engineering coordination mirror for repository inventory, architecture, evidence-model design, decisions, defects, roadmap and release tracking. The application uses its own local SQLite database plus content-addressed workspace files.
fields.Implementation Constraints: Never couple CLI operation to Airtable availability or credentials. No APK uploads, secret values or end-user data in Airtable. Airtable sync is optional and out-of-band.

fields.Existing Code Mapping: Extend src/apkworkbench/decompilation/runner.py and existing JADX/Apktool output layout. New modules proposed: analysis/artifacts.py, analysis/parsers/base.py, analysis/parsers/zip_apk.py, analysis/parsers/androguard.py. Existing output remains consumable.

fields.Target Design: Introduce a normalized read-only ArtifactView over APK, split APK, DEX, AndroidManifest.xml, resources, native libraries, assets and OBB metadata. fields.Implementation Constraints: Treat APK contents as hostile input. ZIP traversal and zip bombs, oversized entries, malformed XML/DEX, decompression ratio, file count, total extracted bytes and parse time must be bounded. Parsers run without network and with least privilege. Never execute APK code.

Reports summarize app/artifact identity, analysis run, analyzers and versions, categories, confidence, verification state, evidence locations, diagnostics and limitations. Preserve current JSON/HTML reports through compatibility adapters.
fields.Implementation Constraints: Do not imply a clean report means safe APK. Never expose unsanitized secrets. Treat all strings from APK as untrusted HTML. Report static-only scope and unsupported surfaces.

fields.Target Design: Run analyzer jobs with deterministic scheduling and explicit resource profiles. Prefer subprocess isolation for heavyweight external tools (MobSF/JADX/Apktool/TruffleHog) and in-process execution only for bounded pure parsers. Capture stdout/stderr to per-execution files with truncation limits. Support cancellation, timeout, retry policy, and resumable execution without rerunning successful analyzers unless inputs/config/tool versions changed.
fields.Implementation Constraints: Set configurable max APK bytes, extracted bytes, entry count, parser wall time, analyzer wall time, output bytes, concurrent jobs and workspace quota. Defaults conservative. External analyzer container network disabled, filesystem scoped read-only input + dedicated writable output.

fields.Interfaces & Contracts: Repository layer owns SQL; domain models must not issue SQL directly. Every write path validates IDs and foreign keys. Migration runner applies ordered migrations atomically and records version/checksum. Exports are generated from stable versioned DTOs, not direct table dumps.
fields.Target Design: Use SQLite as the normalized operational store, with schema version table and transactional migrations. Retain CSV/JSON as import/export interchange and human-readable artifacts, not the primary relational store. Store large raw outputs as content-addressed files with SHA-256 references; DB stores metadata and paths. Enable foreign keys, WAL where appropriate, busy timeout, explicit transactions and backup API.
fields.Implementation Constraints: Never silently overwrite original manifests or historical CSV. Import must be idempotent and preserve source filename, row number, source hash and import timestamp. Back up before migration; rollback or restore on failure. Avoid storing raw secrets in DB/logs.

fields.Existing Code Mapping: Existing TruffleHog scanner remains as one analyzer. fields.Acceptance Tests: Golden fixture corpus per category, positive and negative examples, confidence calibration, rule provenance, false-positive tests, and regression tests across rule pack versions.

fields.Target Design: Build focused deterministic extractors in increments: (1) manifest/components/permissions; (2) endpoints and network service indicators; (3) SDK/cloud/vendor fingerprints; (4) auth and embedded configuration; (5) WebView/JS bridge; (6) network security/TLS/trust configuration; (7) crypto/keystore; (8) dependency/library inventory; (9) secret detection. Keep each category independently runnable and report static evidence only.
fields.Implementation Constraints: Static indicators are not runtime proof. No exploitation, credential use, auth bypass, dynamic testing or external calls. Vendor identification requires multiple corroborating signals where possible. Obfuscation and reflection limit coverage.
